# Evidence and public profile boundary

`research/raimov-profile/` holds source evidence and rights. `docs/ssot/RAIMOV_PUBLIC_PROFILE.md` decides what may be stated publicly. This contour stores process notes and claim-to-source mapping only; it does not duplicate evidence or promote unverified claims.

Case use requires case-level consent, de-identification, media rights and clinical review. Teaching permission and marketing permission must not be inferred from one another.
